name: Superpowers
blurb: A working method for coding agents: ask what the person really wants, write a plan, test first, find the cause of a bug before fixing it, and prove it works before saying so. This is what makes small models far more dependable.
author: Jesse Vincent (obra)
note: Trimmed to six skills that need no extra tools. Subagent and git-worktree skills are left out.
